MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The aluminum foil tape felt useful alongside my recent duct clamps because it could help seal the joints those clamps secure.",
    "Repair supplies fit part of my purchasing history, but the foil tape stood out because it had a concrete connection to my most recent purchase."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The casters, thermometer, electronic cleaner and test leads would require particular projects or equipment needs that my purchases do not establish.",
    "The battery lugs differ from my earlier small-wire connectors in wire size and application, while threaded pipe sealant serves a different purpose from hose or duct clamps.",
    "Buying Gorilla tape and vinyl cement does not mean I currently need clear glue; I choose adhesives for a particular material and repair."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My occasional repair purchases seem to have been treated as interest in almost any workshop supply.",
    "Shared brands and broad similarities such as electrical work or fastening seem to matter too much when the actual uses differ."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My most recent duct clamp purchase provides a more concrete reason to consider duct-sealing tape than unrelated tools or hardware.",
    "Specific fit matters to me: wire gauge, fitting type, material and intended task determine whether a related item is useful.",
    "My purchases are spread over years, so an older tool or supply purchase does not establish an ongoing project or a current need for accessories."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my practical repair interests but often assumed a current need from broad similarities, while the foil tape offered a clear connection to my recent duct clamps."
}
